requirements: Related and Explore cards use the same status information, colors and icons.
Duplicate exclusion, exploration exclusion and quarantine override misleading completed presentation; duplicate candidates are not final duplicate decisions.
Keep processing badges circular at bottom right; short hover descriptions, no extra explanatory paragraphs.
Preserve thumbnail revision/cache behavior, independent per-ID status subscriptions, navigation and background-tab modifiers.
No changes to downloads, recordings, hash/duplicate criteria, existing review edits, original files or accounts.
acceptance: Related cards show duplicate candidates, duplicate exclusion, exploration exclusion, quarantine and all download phases.
Excluded completed albums do not display as available completed items.
Restoring an exclusion updates an open detail card without full reload.
Per-ID progress events retain thumbnail nodes and stale revisions are ignored.
Ctrl-click, double-click and Enter retain existing navigation; no new state polling.

validation.visualInspection: Excluded covers visibly muted; round bottom-right icons and title bounds intact. Synthetic portraits only.
validation.scope: Related/Explore status rendering and existing navigation only. Download/duplicate algorithms, backend, source data and accounts unchanged.
